_help: Copy to config.json (gitignored) or use Settings in the app, which writes it. 'engines' lists the crispz family tools Dataset Studio drives through the CLI protocol v1: 'url' = the app instance (hidden Gradio endpoints cli_caps / cli_edit / cli_faces), 'dir' = its install folder so Dataset Studio can START it when nothing answers (the port of 'url' is passed as GRADIO_SERVER_PORT, the log goes to logs/<name>.log), 'launch' = allow that start, 'loras_dir' = optional, where 'Copy LoRA' puts a trained LoRA (default: the app's own setting, else <dir>/loras), 'python' = optional explicit interpreter (default: <dir>/.venv, then <dir>/env, then py -3). Give each engine ITS OWN port: two family apps on 7860 cannot coexist, and two running at once do not fit on one GPU anyway (Dataset Studio starts one at a time). 'engine' = the default. 'ollama' = the local vision model used when a project's caption_source is 'ollama' or 'both' (empty model = first installed; keep_alive 0 unloads it after each caption, the GPU is shared with the engine).
_output_help: Where exports go, the crispz layout: 'output_dir' (relative = next to the app, like the family's default_output_dir 'out', or an absolute path), a YYYY-MM-DD subfolder when 'date_subfolders' is true, then one LOT folder per export, <project>_<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>/, holding the NNN.png + NNN.txt pairs, with <lot>.zip beside it. Never overwritten (_2, _3 on a same-second collision). The working files stay in projects/<name>/.
_ai_toolkit_help: Optional: the ai-toolkit (Ostris) folder, e.g. D:/Github/AI-Toolkit-Easy-Install/AI-Toolkit-Easy-Install/AI-Toolkit. A folder inside it (output, datasets) or the Easy-Install folder above it works too: the app finds the one holding run.py. When set, a finished dataset offers 'Create AI-Toolkit job': the export is copied to <ai-toolkit>/datasets/<job>/ and <ai-toolkit>/config/<job>.yaml is written (FLUX.2 Klein 4B or 9B recipe). Nothing leaves this PC and nothing starts on its own. 'ai_toolkit_datasets_dir' (optional) overrides the datasets folder.
